name: com.kurtrasmussen.reachout/meetings
title: Reachout recovery meetings
description: Recovery meetings of every fellowship (AA, NA, Al-Anon, SMART...), worldwide, with a secular score.

tools.name: find_meetings_near
tools.description: In-person and hybrid recovery meetings near a point, nearest first, with distance. Use the place's latitude and longitude.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles. Default 25. (Or radius_km.)

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres, instead of radius_miles.

fellowship.description: Fellowship codes, e.g. ["AA", "NA", "AL-ANON", "SMART"]; see list_fellowships. Default: all.

min_secular_score.description: Lowest secular score to include: 3 = secular-friendly or better, 5 = listed as secular. Default 0.

tools.name: list_meetings_in_area
tools.description: All active meetings in one country, or one state or province, page by page (follow next_cursor for more).

country.description: Two-letter country code: US, CA, GB, DE, ...

region.description: State or province code within the country: MN, ON, ... Default: the whole country.

fellowship.description: Fellowship codes, e.g. ["AA", "NA", "AL-ANON", "SMART"]; see list_fellowships. Default: all.

min_secular_score.description: Lowest secular score to include: 3 = secular-friendly or better, 5 = listed as secular. Default 0.

cursor.description: For the next page: next_cursor from the previous answer.

tools.name: find_online_meetings
tools.description: Online meetings (and hybrid ones, which can be joined online) with how to join, page by page.

fellowship.description: Fellowship codes, e.g. ["AA", "NA", "AL-ANON", "SMART"]; see list_fellowships. Default: all.

min_secular_score.description: Lowest secular score to include: 3 = secular-friendly or better, 5 = listed as secular. Default 0.

cursor.description: For the next page: next_cursor from the previous answer.

tools.name: list_fellowships
tools.description: The fellowship codes Reachout uses (AA, NA, AL-ANON, ...), with names and websites.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: The public meeting lists Reachout reads, with links and when each was last read. Give a country or a fellowship (or both).

fellowship.description: Fellowship codes, e.g. ["AA", "NA", "AL-ANON", "SMART"]; see list_fellowships. Default: all.

tools.name: website_code
tools.description: Ready-to-paste HTML and JavaScript for a web page that shows meetings near a place, loaded live from the Reachout API (so it stays current), grouped by day, each linked to its source list, with the Reachout credit badge. Use this when someone wants meetings on their website.

fellowship.description: Fellowship codes, e.g. ["AA", "NA", "AL-ANON", "SMART"]; see list_fellowships. Default: all.

min_secular_score.description: Lowest secular score to include: 3 = secular-friendly or better, 5 = listed as secular. Default 0.

heading.description: Optional heading for the list, e.g. "Meetings near Duluth".
